name: fmr-sdmx-mcp
description: Validate and transform statistical data through the Thailand NSO Fusion Metadata Registry.

interface.longDescription: Validate CSV, XLSX and SDMX datasets against structures in the Thailand NSO Fusion Metadata Registry, then export the validated result in a selected SDMX format.
interface.defaultPrompt: Validate and transform a statistical dataset with the NSO Fusion Metadata Registry. Show validation issues before downloading a converted result.
